data.title: Bitcoin, XRP, Dogecoin Slide, Ethereum Steady as ‘Extreme Fear’ Persists: Analyst Says ‘Selling Hasn’t Stopped Yet’ as Whales Offload BTC
data.description: Leading cryptocurrencies held steady on Monday as investors remained risk-averse after a sharp sell-off.Crypto Market Awaits Relief RallyBitcoin oscillated between $63,800 and $65,500 as traders awaited a rebound that could revive upward momentum.
